description:
"Let the fire within draw heat to your soul, restoring |cffffff15|r% of your missing Magicka and Stamina every |cffffff2|r seconds over |cffffff4|r seconds.

Much of this heat is drawn from enemies around you. Those that are casting are interrupted, set Off Balance, and stunned for |cffffff2|r seconds.

When this ability completes, you release this heat as a blast of fire that deals |cffffff10138|r Flame Damage to nearby enemies."
